headline: Frequent Rework of HiArgs Implementation
diagnosis: The HiArgs struct and its related functionality are undergoing continuous changes, primarily due to issues with indexing and flag management. The commit history indicates a pattern of reverting and re-adding features, suggesting instability in the implementation.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the recent commits focusing on indexing and flag management to identify specific issues causing instability.
Establish a clear definition of the expected behavior for the HiArgs struct, especially regarding indexing and flag interactions.
Implement a comprehensive set of unit tests that cover all edge cases related to the HiArgs struct and its dependencies, particularly focusing on indexing scenarios.
Engage with the authors of the recent commits to gather insights on their changes and establish a more consistent approach moving forward.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the authors of recent commits to ensure collective accountability.
